drivingQuestion: What does the mishna's term kifa denote?
outcomeNote: Rabba's definition of kifa stands unchallenged in this unit.

segments.he: וְהַקֵּיפֶה, מַאי קֵיפֶה? אָמַר רַבָּה: פִּירְמָא.
segments.en: §The mishna teaches: «The spices [kifa]» join together with the meat to constitute the requisite egg-bulk to impart the impurity of food, but an egg-bulk of kifa itself is not susceptible to impurity. The Gemara asks: To «what» is the term «kifa» referring? «Rabba said:» The term kifa is referring to a congealed «hash» of cooked meat that settled to the bottom of the pot.
